<skill>
            # checkoutservice 排查 SOP

## 经验条目

以下条目来自过去的排查记录，括号里是来源。

- [E1]（BH01、BH02、BH03、BH07、BH15）下单/结账 500 且日志出现 `failed to charge card`/`failed to convert price`/`cart failure: failed to get user cart` 等下游 RPC 失败时先看错误语义：`dial tcp <ClusterIP>:<port>: i/o timeout`=地址/端口写错——注意可能是毫秒级快速失败（目标端口无 listener/kube-proxy 规则时立即失败），监控上是 100% 下单失败但 took_ms≈1ms，不要当成延迟或资源问题；`connection refused`=该 Service Endpoints 为空/selector 不匹配（逐个 `get endpoints`）。定位到失败阶段后，把该下游 `*_SERVICE_ADDR` 的端口与 Service 的 port→targetPort、容器实际监听端口（containerPort、启动日志）三方对齐，并与上一版 RS 的 env、`last-applied-configuration` 对比：旧 RS 正确、只有新 RS 错即为运行态被改，改回 env 重建即恢复，不要先改 Service 或重启下游。失败阶段之后的依赖不会有调用日志。
- [E2]（BH05）结账变慢但返回 200、无 failed to charge card 等错误时：把 `[PlaceOrder]` 起始到 payment went through 的耗时按“购物车条目数×下游调用次数”拆解，若≈条目数×固定台阶（如每件约 200ms），说明慢在逐件的货币转换等上游依赖单次调用上，转 currencyservice 等对应服务 SOP 查入向延迟/限流；不要先怀疑 payment 或本服务自身的下单逻辑。

<!-- 经验条目结束 -->

适用症状：用户从 frontend 结账/下单失败，frontend 出现调用 checkoutservice:5050 的错误、超时或 5xx，或 checkoutservice Pod 不 Ready/重启。

## 信号 → 步骤

| 信号 | 动作 |
|---|---|
| frontend 日志/事件显示调用 checkoutservice:5050 失败、超时或 5xx | 第 1 步；若第 2–7 步确认 checkoutservice 侧正常，跳 `boutique-frontend` |
| checkoutservice Pod 非 Running/Ready、重启、CrashLoopBackOff、ImagePullBackOff、OOMKilled、Pending | 第 2 步 |
| Deployment 可用副本为 0，或 ReplicaSet 异常 | 第 2、8 步 |
| checkoutservice 的 EndpointSlice 无 ready 端点，或端口不是 5050 | 第 3 步 |
| Pod 事件出现 Unhealthy、Probe failed | 第 5 步 |
| checkoutservice 日志显示启动失败、端口绑定失败、env/配置异常 | 第 4 步 |
| checkoutservice 日志显示某个下游连接失败/超时 | 第 7 步，并跳对应 `boutique-<下游>` |
| 某个下游 Service/EndpointSlice 无 ready 端点 | 跳对应 `boutique-<下游>` |
| ResourceQuota 限制、事件 FailedCreate/FailedScheduling | 第 6 步 |
| checkoutservice 自身检查均正常，仅 frontend 报 checkout 错误 | 跳 `boutique-frontend` |

## 步骤

1. 定位失败面：看 frontend 日志/事件中与 checkout 相关的错误，记录时间、错误码/超时、目标地址；同时看 checkoutservice Pod 当前状态。目的：区分“frontend → checkoutservice:5050 入口问题”和“checkoutservice → 下游调用问题”。无监控指标，不要依赖 CPU、内存、延迟曲线。

2. 查 Deployment/ReplicaSet/Pod：`kubectl -n boutique get deploy,rs,pods -l app=checkoutservice -o wide`，再 `describe` 异常 Pod。确认副本数为 1、Pod Running 且 Ready、重启次数。ImagePullBackOff/ErrImagePull 查镜像 `v0.10.3` 与拉取事件；CrashLoopBackOff 结合 `kubectl -n boutique logs <pod> --previous`；OOMKilled 对应内存 limit 128Mi；Pending/FailedScheduling 记录事件并转第 6 步；Unhealthy 转第 5 步。清单未列出 ConfigMap 引用；若事件出现 ConfigMap 相关引用，先确认是否有人改动，不按不存在的配置项推断。

3. 查 Service 与 EndpointSlice：`kubectl -n boutique get svc checkoutservice -o yaml`、`kubectl -n boutique get endpointslice -l kubernetes.io/service-name=checkoutservice -o yaml`。确认 Service selector 为 `app: checkoutservice`，port/targetPort 均为 5050；EndpointSlice 应有 ready=true 的 5050 地址。无端点通常是 Pod 未 Ready 或 selector 不匹配；端口不匹配是 Service 配置问题。记录对象和证据。

4. 查 checkoutservice 日志：看当前 Pod 日志和崩溃前日志，查找启动失败、端口绑定失败、探针失败、连接下游失败/超时、异常退出等明确错误。不要假设日志格式；记录原始错误片段和时间。若日志指向某个下游地址，转第 7 步。核对 Deployment env 是否与清单一致：`PORT=5050`，六个下游地址分别为 `productcatalogservice:3550`、`shippingservice:50051`、`paymentservice:50051`、`emailservice:5000`、`currencyservice:7000`、`cartservice:7070`；缺失或错误记为本服务配置问题。

5. 查探针：readinessProbe 和 livenessProbe 都是 gRPC 5050。Pod 事件若出现 Probe failed/Unhealthy，结合日志判断进程是否监听 5050、是否启动即崩溃或阻塞。不能进容器执行探测，结论用事件加日志。readiness 失败会导致 EndpointSlice 无 ready 端点，frontend 调用失败；liveness 失败会导致 Pod 重启。探针端口若被改成非 5050，记录为本服务配置问题。

6. 查资源与配额：Deployment requests 为 100m/64Mi，limits 为 200m/128Mi。看 Pod describe 是否 OOMKilled，查命名空间 ResourceQuota 和 FailedCreate/FailedScheduling 事件。无 CPU/内存指标，不能仅凭现象判断 CPU 饱和；CPU 限流无法直接观测，先确认事件、日志和下游正常性。若频繁重启且 OOMKilled，才归因内存限制。

7. 逐项核对下游入口：对六个下游分别看 Service 端口和 EndpointSlice ready，并核对第 4 步的 env 地址：productcatalogservice:3550、shippingservice:50051、paymentservice:50051、emailservice:5000、currencyservice:7000、cartservice:7070。某下游无 ready 端点、Service 不存在或端口不匹配，跳对应 skill；下游入口正常但 checkout 日志仍报该下游超时/错误，也跳对应 skill 继续确认应用侧。不要直接查 redis-cart；cartservice 的下游由 cartservice skill 处理。

8. 查最近变更和单点风险：看 ReplicaSet 历史、Pod 模板镜像是否为 `v0.10.3`、env/探针/资源是否与清单一致。副本数为 1，Pod 重启或不 Ready 期间没有其他副本承接。若新 ReplicaSet 对应异常 Pod，记录为发布变更嫌疑。ConfigMap 只在有实际引用或事件时确认。

9. 汇总结论：把证据落到具体对象。若 checkoutservice 自身异常，结论写 checkoutservice 的 Deployment/Pod/Service/EndpointSlice 及原因；若下游异常，跳对应 skill 并把结论写在该下游对象；若 checkoutservice 侧正常而 frontend 调用失败，回 frontend 并把结论写在 frontend。

## 什么时候跳到别的服务

- checkoutservice 日志/事件出现 productcatalogservice:3550 连接失败、超时，或 productcatalogservice 的 Service/EndpointSlice 无 ready 端点 → 跳 `boutique-productcatalogservice`；结论写 productcatalogservice 对应对象。
- checkoutservice 日志/事件出现 shippingservice:50051 连接失败、超时，或 shippingservice 的 Service/EndpointSlice 无 ready 端点 → 跳 `boutique-shippingservice`；结论写 shippingservice 对应对象。
- checkoutservice 日志/事件出现 paymentservice:50051 连接失败、超时，或 paymentservice 的 Service/EndpointSlice 无 ready 端点 → 跳 `boutique-paymentservice`；结论写 paymentservice 对应对象。
- checkoutservice 日志/事件出现 emailservice:5000 连接失败、超时，或 emailservice 的 Service/EndpointSlice 无 ready 端点 → 跳 `boutique-emailservice`；结论写 emailservice 对应对象。
- checkoutservice 日志/事件出现 currencyservice:7000 连接失败、超时，或 currencyservice 的 Service/EndpointSlice 无 ready 端点 → 跳 `boutique-currencyservice`；结论写 currencyservice 对应对象。
- checkoutservice 日志/事件出现 cartservice:7070 连接失败、超时，或 cartservice 的 Service/EndpointSlice 无 ready 端点 → 跳 `boutique-cartservice`；结论写 cartservice 对应对象。不要直接跳 redis-cart。
- frontend 日志显示无法连接 checkoutservice:5050、调用超时或 5xx，但第 2–7 步确认 checkoutservice Pod、Service、EndpointSlice、日志、资源、探针均正常 → 跳 `boutique-frontend`；结论写在 frontend 对应对象。若 checkoutservice 侧已有异常证据，不要回 frontend，结论写 checkoutservice。
- 不要跳到未直接调用的服务；loadgenerator 仅作为流量来源，不作为跳转或结论对象。

## 结论怎么写

结论必须写清对象、原因、证据：对象写 checkoutservice 的 Deployment/Pod/Service/EndpointSlice，或具体下游/frontend 的对应对象；原因写如 Pod 未 Ready 导致 EndpointSlice 无端点、OOMKilled 触发内存 limit、env 地址错误、探针失败、Service selector/端口错误、下游不可达；证据写 Pod describe 事件、日志原始片段、EndpointSlice ready 状态、Deployment env/镜像/探针/资源 spec、ResourceQuota 事件。

判到下游时，结论写在该下游对象上并注明“checkoutservice 侧仅表现为调用失败”；判到 frontend 时，结论写在 frontend 对象上。

            # Online Boutique 排查总则

## 经验条目

以下条目来自过去的排查记录，括号里是来源。

- [E1]（BH01、BH02、BH03、BH04）先按症状分类：同时报“慢”和“下单失败”通常为两个独立故障，分别定位。失败类：看错误语义与耗时——首次数秒超时后 2–3ms 快速失败=某下游 `*_SERVICE_ADDR` 端口/地址配错（对比当前与上一版 ReplicaSet env、Service port 与容器实际监听端口）；connection refused=Service 无 Endpoints/selector 不匹配，逐个 `get endpoints`。延迟类：看耗时是否与“调用次数”成比例。若多类页面/多个下游同时呈同一固定台阶（每次调用 +200~300ms），而同一窗口内另一组调用仍 1–2.5ms（如 checkout↔shipping/payment/email），说明台阶附着在一批 Pod 上，属运行期延迟注入，不是节点 CPU、全局网络或单服务 CPU 限流（限流应有 cgroup throttle 证据且随负载波动；Pod 健康、配置未变、无 error 也支持此判）。页面耗时≈该页调用受影响服务的次数×台阶，可据此反推受影响集合。也可用时间戳对齐：下游日志“收到请求”晚于调用方发起、而该下游处理仅毫秒级→延迟在到达前。处置：重建这些 Pod；重建后数字完全不变=集群侧按 label 重放的注入（chaos/sidecar/tc），转运维，不要反复重启。以 Pod 创建/版本切换时间为界对比前后基线。
- [E2]（BH05、BH06、BH09）『整站或部分页面变慢、0 个 500、Pod 全 Running/0 重启、env/资源/镜像未变』时按四步收敛，不要先调 CPU limit：①前端日志按路径分桶耗时，用最快路径反证——如 POST /cart 仅 1–2ms，即 productcatalog/cart/redis 全链健康；②页面耗时≈该页调用嫌疑服务的次数×台阶，据此反推唯一嫌疑服务（只有 /cart、/cart/checkout 慢而 /、/product 正常→shippingservice，checkout 约 2×台阶是同一下游 RPC 被调两次）；③复核该服务 Deployment 的 env、资源、镜像、Service targetPort、Endpoints；④时间戳对齐：调用方发出时刻 vs 被查服务 handler 入口日志恒定晚约一个台阶而处理瞬时完成=入向网络延迟（重建该 Pod，无效则转运维查 veth 上 tc/netem），延迟落在响应返回侧则为出向。注入延迟通常小于探针超时，Pod 仍 Ready、无 Unhealthy 事件不能排除网络注入。同一窗口内毫秒级 connection refused（如副本被缩到 0、selector 写错致 Endpoints 为空）只造成降级，按错误语义单独修，不并入延迟归因。
- [E3]（BH07、BH10）同一秒出现 `Scaled up replica set <新> from 0 to 1` 与旧 RS `Scaled down ... from 1 to 0`，通常就是变更注入时刻：以该时间点为准横向检查所有 Deployment 的 replicas、env、镜像，以及所有 Service 的 selector 与 port→targetPort——同一次注入常同时改多个对象（如一个 Service 端口写错 + 另一个 selector 写错）。connection refused 只有两种来源：selector 不匹配致 Endpoints 为空（subsets: null），或 Endpoints 有地址但 targetPort≠容器实际监听端口（对照 containerPort 与 Pod 启动日志 `Now listening on: ...:7070`）。是否算根因取决于调用方能否降级：cartservice/productcatalog 这类每页必经的挂了→大量 500、下单全失败但响应仅 1–3ms（不是资源/延迟问题）；ad、推荐、邮件可降级→页面仍 200 只内容缺失，只单独恢复，不并入延迟/失败归因。修复后按该时刻前后对比：500 归零、下单成功率恢复、对应报错日志消失，延迟分位数不应变差。
- [E4]（BH08）耗时台阶看似卡在某下游、该服务入向指标又不足以解释时，把口径下沉到“下游操作条数”：同一页 1 条缓存/DB 命令≈X ms、2 条≈2X ms，而无该跳的接口仍 0–2ms，则台阶固定在该跳每次往返上（若 2 条接口只有≈1.5X，才是延迟附着在中间 Pod 的整体网络路径）。同时别被“最近变更”误导：某 Deployment 刚 rollout 或 env 与 last-applied 不一致时看时间线——新 Pod 就绪后若曾连续数十秒正常服务，即可排除该变更，回到台阶定位；节点级 CPU/throttle 指标不可得时，用同窗口其他服务毫秒级间接排除节点问题。
- [E5]（BH11、BH12、BH13、BH14、BH15）尾部延迟呈“概率型”：中位数正常、p90/p99 抬高、约 4–9%（也可能到 20%）请求超阈值、无 5xx、Pod 全 Ready、env/资源/镜像未变。不要按 E2 找“每次调用都加台阶的入向延迟”。先看慢值分布定机制：①慢值是基线+100ms 整数倍、成簇、随机 0–100ms→单线程/多模块且 CPU limit 偏低的 Pod 被 CFS 冻结（查 nr_throttled；无权限就只把嫌疑服务的 limit 提到 1）；②慢值量化在 ~200ms（400/600ms）整数倍、各并发请求起跑不同却同一瞬间返回→TCP 重传，问题在被调 Pod 的网络路径；③看本 Pod 探针，`i/o timeout` 或 `timeout: failed to connect service <podIP>:<port> within 1s` 都指向该 Pod 自身的网络或停顿（探针直连 Pod、绕开调用方；同窗口只有它异常即可排除节点级丢包），据此确定是哪个 Pod。确定后一次只重启/修改这一个对象并复测 >180ms 占比，不要同时重启多个候选服务做“验证”，否则无法判断原因，下游日志里的孤立的数百毫秒空档只能当备选证据。用只含单次下游往返的干净区间做严格隔离。

<!-- 经验条目结束 -->

## 1. 权限与证据边界

- 只在命名空间 `boutique` 内排查，使用只读权限。
- 可查看：Pod、Pod 日志、事件、Service、EndpointSlice、Deployment、ReplicaSet、ConfigMap、ResourceQuota。
- 不可用：进入容器执行命令、查看节点、查看监控指标；系统没有 CPU、内存、延迟指标。
- 结论必须来自上述可见证据。无法验证的内容写成“先确认……”或“现有权限内无法确认”，不要根据服务名、调用关系或常见经验直接下根因。
- 不要编造日志格式、接口、配置项；日志字段含义先确认。

## 2. 调用关系

- 用户从 `frontend` 进入。
- `loadgenerator` 持续产生访问流量；其具体访问目标先确认，不纳入下列服务调用图，也不假设存在 `boutique-loadgenerator`。
- `frontend` -> `productcatalogservice`、`currencyservice`、`cartservice`、`recommendationservice`、`shippingservice`、`checkoutservice`、`adservice`
- `checkoutservice` -> `productcatalogservice`、`shippingservice`、`paymentservice`、`emailservice`、`currencyservice`、`cartservice`
- `recommendationservice` -> `productcatalogservice`
- `cartservice` -> `redis-cart`
- 不调用其他服务：`emailservice`、`paymentservice`、`productcatalogservice`、`currencyservice`、`shippingservice`、`adservice`、`redis-cart`

调用关系只表示依赖方向，不等于故障传播方向。

## 3. 入口 SOP 选择

先固定用户症状：发生时间、频率、影响的功能/操作、是否持续、是否与 `loadgenerator` 流量相关。不要先假定某个服务故障。

默认规则：

- 用户可见问题且无法明确指向某个后端服务：从 `boutique-frontend` 进入。
- 症状或已有证据明确指向某个服务及其对应操作：可直接进入该服务 SOP；仍要按第 4 节确认证据，不要跳过入口症状。
- 只有 `loadgenerator` 报错：先确认其访问目标和错误内容；若指向 `frontend` 或用户访问路径，从 `boutique-frontend` 进入。不要假设存在 `loadgenerator` 的 SOP。
- 不明确时回退到 `boutique-frontend`。

| 症状/已有证据明确指向 | 入口 skill |
|---|---|
| `frontend` 页面、入口、多个功能同时异常，或无法判断后端 | `boutique-frontend` |
| 商品目录、商品信息 | `boutique-productcatalogservice` |
| 币种、换算 | `boutique-currencyservice` |
| 购物车操作 | `boutique-cartservice` |
| 推荐内容 | `boutique-recommendationservice` |
| 运费、配送 | `boutique-shippingservice` |
| 下单、结账编排 | `boutique-checkoutservice` |
| 支付 | `boutique-paymentservice` |
| 邮件通知 | `boutique-emailservice` |
| 广告 | `boutique-adservice` |

[ "$SEL_LABELS" = "None" ] && SEL_LABELS=""

[ "$FILTER_PATTERN" = "None" ] && FILTER_PATTERN=""

    SEL_NAMESPACE=""
  fi
fi

  SCOPE_ARGS+=(--all-namespaces)

  SCOPE_ARGS+=(--field-selector "$SEL_FIELDS")

#!/bin/bash

# SECURITY: assign sanitized params to shell variables in an unquoted
# assignment slot, then reference them only as "$VAR". Never interpolate
#  inside a quoted context - sanitize() (shlex.quote) wraps
# dangerous values in single quotes, which are literal (and command
# substitution stays active) inside a double-quoted or single-quoted slot.
KIND=replicasets
# 'namespace' is also a Jinja global (namespace()), so it is defined even when omitted
SEL_NAMESPACE=boutique
SEL_LABELS=
SEL_FIELDS=
# Strict tool calls send null for unset optional params, which renders as 'None'
[ "$SEL_NAMESPACE" = "None" ] && SEL_NAMESPACE=""
[ "$SEL_LABELS" = "None" ] && SEL_LABELS=""
[ "$SEL_FIELDS" = "None" ] && SEL_FIELDS=""

# Collapse multi-line jq expressions (LLMs sometimes write multi-line jq)
# Note: use $'\n' syntax instead of '\n' because Jinja2 interprets \n as literal newlines
JQ_FILTER='.items[] | {rs: .metadata.name, created: .metadata.creationTimestamp, replicas: .spec.replicas, ready: .status.readyReplicas, env: [.spec.template.spec.containers[0].env[]? | "\(.name)=\(.value)"]}'
JQ_FILTER=$(printf '%s' "$JQ_FILTER" | tr $'\n\r' '  ')

err_file=$(mktemp)
PROCESSED=0
NOTES='[]'
SCOPE='null'

add_note() {
  NOTES=$(jq -c --arg note "$1" '. + [$note]' <<< "$NOTES")
}

uri_encode() {
  jq -rn --arg v "$1" '$v|@uri'
}

fail() {
  err_content=$(cat "$err_file" 2>/dev/null)
  rm -f "$err_file"
  jq -n --arg stderr "$1 $err_content" --argjson total "$PROCESSED" --argjson notes "$NOTES" --argjson scope "$SCOPE" \
    '{total_items_processed: $total, matches_found: 0, results: [], stderr: $stderr, scope: $scope, notes: $notes}'
  exit 0
}

# The namespace becomes part of the raw API path, so anything other than a valid
# namespace name (e.g. 'default/services/x:80/proxy/?') could reach other API endpoints
if [ -n "$SEL_NAMESPACE" ] && ! [[ "$SEL_NAMESPACE" =~ ^[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$ ]]; then
  fail "Invalid namespace '${SEL_NAMESPACE}': must be a Kubernetes namespace name (lowercase letters, digits and '-')."
fi

# Get the API path for the resource kind using kubectl
# Match the resource name (first column) as an EXACT string, not a
# grep regex - otherwise a kind like '.*' or 'a|b' would match the
# wrong resource.
CANDIDATES=$(kubectl api-resources --no-headers 2>>"$err_file" | awk -v kind="$KIND" '$1 == kind')
API_INFO=$(printf '%s\n' "$CANDIDATES" | head -1)
# `kubectl api-resources` sorts by group name, so a CRD reusing a built-in
# plural (e.g. Calico's crd.projectcalico.org networkpolicies) can be listed
# before networking.k8s.io. Pick what `kubectl get` picks: the core group,
# then the first group in server discovery order (/apis).
if [ "$(printf '%s\n' "$CANDIDATES" | grep -c .)" -gt 1 ] && [[ "$API_INFO" != *" v1 "* ]]; then
  API_GROUPS=$(kubectl get --raw /apis 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.groups[].name' 2>/dev/null)
  if [ -z "$API_GROUPS" ]; then
    add_note "Several API groups serve '${KIND}' and server discovery (/apis) failed, so the first group listed by kubectl api-resources was used."
  fi
  for group in $API_GROUPS; do
    match=$(printf '%s\n' "$CANDIDATES" | grep -F " $group/" | head -1)
    if [ -n "$match" ]; then
      API_INFO="$match"
      break
    fi
  done
fi

if [ -z "$API_INFO" ]; then
  fail "Unable to find resource kind '${KIND}'."
fi

# Extract NAMESPACED value
if [[ "$API_INFO" == *" true "* ]]; then
  NAMESPACED=true
  PREFIX=$(echo "$API_INFO" | sed 's/ true .*//')
elif [[ "$API_INFO" == *" false "* ]]; then
  NAMESPACED=false
  PREFIX=$(echo "$API_INFO" | sed 's/ false .*//')
else
  fail "Could not parse API info for '${KIND}'."
fi

# Trim trailing spaces from prefix and collapse internal spaces
PREFIX=$(echo "$PREFIX" | sed 's/  *$//' | sed 's/  */ /g')

IFS=' ' read -ra PREFIX_FIELDS <<< "$PREFIX"
FIELD_COUNT=0
for field in "${PREFIX_FIELDS[@]}"; do
  ((FIELD_COUNT++))
done

RESOURCE_NAME="${PREFIX_FIELDS[0]}"
if [ $FIELD_COUNT -ge 2 ]; then
  API_VERSION="${PREFIX_FIELDS[$((FIELD_COUNT - 1))]}"
else
  API_VERSION=""
fi

if [ -z "$API_VERSION" ] || [ -z "$RESOURCE_NAME" ]; then
  fail "Unable to parse API info for resource kind '${KIND}'."
fi

# Build API path: namespaced kinds can be listed within one namespace;
# cluster-scoped kinds ignore the namespace (as kubectl does)
if [[ "$API_VERSION" == "v1" ]]; then
  API_BASE="/api/v1"
else
  API_BASE="/apis/${API_VERSION}"
fi
if [ -n "$SEL_NAMESPACE" ] && [ "$NAMESPACED" = "true" ]; then
  API_PATH="${API_BASE}/namespaces/${SEL_NAMESPACE}/${RESOURCE_NAME}"
else
  if [ -n "$SEL_NAMESPACE" ]; then
    add_note "namespace '${SEL_NAMESPACE}' ignored: ${RESOURCE_NAME} is cluster-scoped."
    SEL_NAMESPACE=""
  fi
  API_PATH="${API_BASE}/${RESOURCE_NAME}"
fi

SELECTOR_QUERY=""
if [ -n "$SEL_LABELS" ]; then
  SELECTOR_QUERY="${SELECTOR_QUERY}&labelSelector=$(uri_encode "$SEL_LABELS")"
fi
if [ -n "$SEL_FIELDS" ]; then
  SELECTOR_QUERY="${SELECTOR_QUERY}&fieldSelector=$(uri_encode "$SEL_FIELDS")"
fi

SCOPE=$(jq -nc --arg resource "$RESOURCE_NAME" --arg api_version "$API_VERSION" \
  --arg namespace "$SEL_NAMESPACE" --arg labels "$SEL_LABELS" --arg fields "$SEL_FIELDS" \
  '{resource: $resource, api_version: $api_version,
    namespace: (if $namespace == "" then null else $namespace end),
    label_selector: (if $labels == "" then null else $labels end),
    field_selector: (if $fields == "" then null else $fields end)}')

# Process resources in chunks using API pagination
LIMIT=500
CONTINUE=""
TOTAL_MATCHES=0
ALL_MATCHES=""

while true; do
  QUERY="${API_PATH}?limit=${LIMIT}${SELECTOR_QUERY}"
  if [ -n "$CONTINUE" ]; then
    # continue tokens are base64 and may contain '+', '/' or '='
    QUERY="${QUERY}&continue=$(uri_encode "$CONTINUE")"
  fi

  OUTPUT=$(kubectl get --raw "$QUERY" 2>>"$err_file")
  exit_code=$?

  if [ $exit_code -ne 0 ]; then
    fail "kubectl get --raw failed for $QUERY."
  fi

  ITEMS_COUNT=$(echo "$OUTPUT" | jq '.items | length')

  MATCHES=$(echo "$OUTPUT" | jq -c "$JQ_FILTER" 2>>"$err_file")
  jq_exit=$?
  if [ $jq_exit -ne 0 ]; then
    fail "jq expression failed."
  fi

  if [ "$ITEMS_COUNT" -gt 0 ]; then
    if [ -n "$MATCHES" ]; then
      if [ -z "$ALL_MATCHES" ]; then
        ALL_MATCHES="$MATCHES"
      else
        ALL_MATCHES="$ALL_MATCHES"$'\n'"$MATCHES"
      fi
      MATCH_COUNT=$(echo "$MATCHES" | grep -c . || true)
      TOTAL_MATCHES=$((TOTAL_MATCHES + MATCH_COUNT))
    fi
    PROCESSED=$((PROCESSED + ITEMS_COUNT))
  fi

  CONTINUE=$(echo "$OUTPUT" | jq -r '.metadata.continue // empty')

  if [ -z "$CONTINUE" ]; then
    break
  fi
done

err_content=$(cat "$err_file" 2>/dev/null)
rm -f "$err_file"

# Output results as a JSON object with metadata. Results go through stdin, not --argjson:
# Linux caps a single argument at 128KB, so larger results failed with "Argument list too long".
printf '%s\n' "$ALL_MATCHES" | jq -s \
  --argjson total_items_processed "$PROCESSED" \
  --argjson matches_found "$TOTAL_MATCHES" \
  --arg stderr "$err_content" \
  --argjson scope "$SCOPE" \
  --argjson notes "$NOTES" \
  '{total_items_processed: $total_items_processed, matches_found: $matches_found, results: ., stderr: (if $stderr == "" then null else $stderr end), scope: $scope, notes: $notes}'

I found a skill named **boutique-triage-overview（Online Boutique 排查总则）** and **boutique-checkoutservice** and used them to troubleshoot:

1. ✅ *按症状分类* — "慢"和"下单失败"是两个独立故障，分开定位
2. ✅ *列出全部 Pod/Service/EndpointSlice* — 12 个 Pod 全 Running、0 重启、0 ready=0 的端点；各 Service selector/port 与 endpoint 端口一致（emailservice 5000→8080 属正常）
3. ✅ *对比 Deployment / ReplicaSet env 与 revision* — 抓到 checkoutservice 的 env 漂移
4. ✅ *读 checkoutservice 启动日志与 frontend 错误日志* — 定位失败阶段与错误语义
5. ✅ *前端日志按路径分桶耗时* — 只有 `GET /cart`（~300ms）异常，`/product` 9–12ms、`/` 12–58ms、`POST /cart` 1–2ms
6. ✅ *时间戳对齐（调用方发起 vs 下游 handler 入口）* — 把 300ms 定位到 frontend→shippingservice 这一段
7. ✅ *loadgenerator 统计交叉验证* — 确认慢的只有 cart 页
8. ❌ *查看节点 / tc/netem / CPU throttle 指标* — 无节点、无监控指标权限，无法进一步确认延迟注入方式
9. ❌ *重建 Pod 验证是否集群侧重放* — 只读权限，不能执行

---

## 结论：两个互不相关的故障

### 故障 A — 所有下单失败（500）：checkoutservice 的下游地址端口写错

`Deployment/checkoutservice`（revision 92，新 RS `checkoutservice-6d4fdcc4b4`，pod `checkoutservice-6d4fdcc4b4-jrps7`）自身的启动日志直接打出错误配置：

```
service config: &{... productCatalogSvcAddr:productcatalogservice:3551 ...}
```

- 旧 RS `checkoutservice-5d5f4589c5`（replicas 0，11-15 创建）与 `kubectl.kubernetes.io/last-applied-configuration` 都是 **`productcatalogservice:3550`**，只有当前运行态是 **3551** → 运行态被改。
- `Service/productcatalogservice` 只暴露 3550→3550，容器 `containerPort` 也是 3550，3551 无 listener/kube-proxy 规则。
- 后果与错误语义吻合：frontend `POST /cart/checkout` 全部 500，`took_ms` 只有 1–2ms（快速失败）：
  `{"error":"failed to complete the order: rpc error: code = Internal desc = failed to prepare order: failed to get product #\"2ZYFJ3GM2N\"" ... "took_ms":2}`
- 通道首次解析时曾挂住：10:28:18.114 三个 checkout 同时以 18536ms / 5932ms / 5641ms 失败结束（同一瞬间释放，符合 gRPC 对不可达后端的连接尝试超时）。
- 反证：10:27:57.402 旧 Pod 还在时 `POST /cart/checkout` 返回 **200，86ms**；换到新 RS 后 100% 失败。loadgenerator 统计 `POST /cart/checkout 23 reqs, 22 fails (95.65%), median 3ms`。

### 故障 B — 商城变慢：frontend→shippingservice 请求路径多出约 300ms

购物车页是全站唯一调用 shippingservice 的页面（`GetQuote`），它的耗时 100% 从 ~9ms 跳到 ~283–351ms。逐条时间戳对齐（同一秒内）：

| 购物车页 | 页面开始 | shipping 收到 GetQuote | shipping 处理 | 页面完成 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 正常（10:28:24） | 24.0998 | 24.1049 (**+5ms**) | <0.1ms | 24.1088 |
| 异常（10:28:26） | 26.584 | 26.8629 (**+279ms**) | <0.1ms | 26.8672 |
| 异常（10:28:27） | 27.322 | 27.6567 (**+335ms**) | <0.1ms | 27.6592 |

即：请求到达 shippingservice handler 前已经晚了约 300ms，handler 本身瞬时完成，之后 4–5ms 页面就结束了 → 延迟在**请求方向**的前端→shippingservice 链路上，不在 shipping 的业务逻辑、也不是响应返回侧。

同页其它跳全部被证明是毫秒级，因此可以排除它们：
- currencyservice：页面开始的 `getCurrencies` 在 +0ms 就到达（47.092/47.105/48.100/48.455/49.789…），瞬时返回；
- cartservice + redis：`POST /cart`（AddItemAsync，写 redis）全程 **1–2ms**；
- productcatalogservice：`POST /cart` 里的 GetProduct **1–2ms**，`GET /product/*` 全链 8–14ms；
- recommendationservice：`GET /product/*` 含推荐调用仍 8–14ms（且购物车页并不调用推荐）。

shippingservice 自身状态完全正常：pod `shippingservice-78969f44cf-fvxjd`（10.244.0.242）Ready、restartCount 0、单容器无 sidecar、镜像 v0.10.3、env `PORT=50051`/`DISABLE_PROFILER=1` 与 last-applied 一致、无任何 Pod 事件；探针周期 5s/10s、超时 1s，300ms 小于超时所以不会触发 Unhealthy（与"无 Unhealthy 事件"一致，不能据此排除延迟）。

时间线：10:28:24.109 的购物车页还是 9ms，10:28:26.867 已变 283ms → 注入起点约在 **10:28:25**，此时无任何 Pod 重建/配置变更（Pod 都是 10:27:04 创建），属运行期网络侧变化。loadgenerator 汇总印证：`GET /cart` min 8 / median 310 / max 352，`POST /cart` median 310（locust 跟随 302 跳转），其余接口 median 10–23ms。

用户侧的 184/45s 指标对得上：33 个 >180ms 正好约等于购物车页的访问量（~0.7/s），6 个 500 / 6 次下单失败全部来自 checkoutservice。

## 已排除 / 未确认

- 已排除：productcatalogservice、currencyservice、cartservice、redis-cart、recommendationservice、frontend 自身 Pod（全部 Running、0 重启、日志无 error、对应操作毫秒级）；也排除节点级 CPU 或全局网络（同一窗口内大量跳仍 1–2ms）。

A node condition does not tell you which pods it hit; a failing dependency does not tell you which of its clients broke; an unhealthy shared component does not mean its consumers are unhealthy. Check each entity before you name it, or do not name it — sampling a workload's replicas characterizes the WORKLOAD, so attribute what you found to it rather than to replicas you did not look at.

A pod that is 5 minutes old on a node that had trouble 5 minutes ago was not necessarily evicted — check what created it. Coincidence in time is not causation, and "also affected" is a claim that needs its own evidence.

If you cannot quote such a token for that entity, it does not go here — `SuccessfulDelete`, `SuccessfulCreate`, `Scheduled`, `Started` and a probe miss at startup are not among them. A recreation, restart or probe miss inside the window is never enough on its own, whatever sub-label you give it; **Checked, healthy** — you looked and found nothing wrong; **Changed during the window for another reason** — it restarted, was recreated or errored, and you name what did it (a controller rollout, a scheduled job, an operator, a probe at startup) and how you know; **Not checked**. | frontend 日志/事件显示调用 checkoutservice:5050 失败、超时或 5xx | 第 1 步；若第 2–7 步确认 checkoutservice 侧正常，跳 `boutique-frontend` |
| checkoutservice Pod 非 Running/Ready、重启、CrashLoopBackOff、ImagePullBackOff、OOMKilled、Pending | 第 2 步 |
| Deployment 可用副本为 0，或 ReplicaSet 异常 | 第 2、8 步 |
| checkoutservice 的 EndpointSlice 无 ready 端点，或端口不是 5050 | 第 3 步 |
| Pod 事件出现 Unhealthy、Probe failed | 第 5 步 |
| checkoutservice 日志显示启动失败、端口绑定失败、env/配置异常 | 第 4 步 |
| checkoutservice 日志显示某个下游连接失败/超时 | 第 7 步，并跳对应 `boutique-<下游>` |
| 某个下游 Service/EndpointSlice 无 ready 端点 | 跳对应 `boutique-<下游>` |
| ResourceQuota 限制、事件 FailedCreate/FailedScheduling | 第 6 步 |
| checkoutservice 自身检查均正常，仅 frontend 报 checkout 错误 | 跳 `boutique-frontend` |

## 步骤

1. 定位失败面：看 frontend 日志/事件中与 checkout 相关的错误，记录时间、错误码/超时、目标地址；同时看 checkoutservice Pod 当前状态。目的：区分“frontend → checkoutservice:5050 入口问题”和“checkoutservice → 下游调用问题”。无监控指标，不要依赖 CPU、内存、延迟曲线。

2. 查 Deployment/ReplicaSet/Pod：`kubectl -n boutique get deploy,rs,pods -l app=checkoutservice -o wide`，再 `describe` 异常 Pod。确认副本数为 1、Pod Running 且 Ready、重启次数。ImagePullBackOff/ErrImagePull 查镜像 `v0.10.3` 与拉取事件；CrashLoopBackOff 结合 `kubectl -n boutique logs <pod> --previous`；OOMKilled 对应内存 limit 128Mi；Pending/FailedScheduling 记录事件并转第 6 步；Unhealthy 转第 5 步。清单未列出 ConfigMap 引用；若事件出现 ConfigMap 相关引用，先确认是否有人改动，不按不存在的配置项推断。

3. 查 Service 与 EndpointSlice：`kubectl -n boutique get svc checkoutservice -o yaml`、`kubectl -n boutique get endpointslice -l kubernetes.io/service-name=checkoutservice -o yaml`。确认 Service selector 为 `app: checkoutservice`，port/targetPort 均为 5050；EndpointSlice 应有 ready=true 的 5050 地址。无端点通常是 Pod 未 Ready 或 selector 不匹配；端口不匹配是 Service 配置问题。记录对象和证据。

4. 查 checkoutservice 日志：看当前 Pod 日志和崩溃前日志，查找启动失败、端口绑定失败、探针失败、连接下游失败/超时、异常退出等明确错误。不要假设日志格式；记录原始错误片段和时间。若日志指向某个下游地址，转第 7 步。核对 Deployment env 是否与清单一致：`PORT=5050`，六个下游地址分别为 `productcatalogservice:3550`、`shippingservice:50051`、`paymentservice:50051`、`emailservice:5000`、`currencyservice:7000`、`cartservice:7070`；缺失或错误记为本服务配置问题。

5. 查探针：readinessProbe 和 livenessProbe 都是 gRPC 5050。Pod 事件若出现 Probe failed/Unhealthy，结合日志判断进程是否监听 5050、是否启动即崩溃或阻塞。不能进容器执行探测，结论用事件加日志。readiness 失败会导致 EndpointSlice 无 ready 端点，frontend 调用失败；liveness 失败会导致 Pod 重启。探针端口若被改成非 5050，记录为本服务配置问题。

6. 查资源与配额：Deployment requests 为 100m/64Mi，limits 为 200m/128Mi。看 Pod describe 是否 OOMKilled，查命名空间 ResourceQuota 和 FailedCreate/FailedScheduling 事件。无 CPU/内存指标，不能仅凭现象判断 CPU 饱和；CPU 限流无法直接观测，先确认事件、日志和下游正常性。若频繁重启且 OOMKilled，才归因内存限制。

7. 逐项核对下游入口：对六个下游分别看 Service 端口和 EndpointSlice ready，并核对第 4 步的 env 地址：productcatalogservice:3550、shippingservice:50051、paymentservice:50051、emailservice:5000、currencyservice:7000、cartservice:7070。某下游无 ready 端点、Service 不存在或端口不匹配，跳对应 skill；下游入口正常但 checkout 日志仍报该下游超时/错误，也跳对应 skill 继续确认应用侧。不要直接查 redis-cart；cartservice 的下游由 cartservice skill 处理。

8. 查最近变更和单点风险：看 ReplicaSet 历史、Pod 模板镜像是否为 `v0.10.3`、env/探针/资源是否与清单一致。副本数为 1，Pod 重启或不 Ready 期间没有其他副本承接。若新 ReplicaSet 对应异常 Pod，记录为发布变更嫌疑。ConfigMap 只在有实际引用或事件时确认。

9. 汇总结论：把证据落到具体对象。若 checkoutservice 自身异常，结论写 checkoutservice 的 Deployment/Pod/Service/EndpointSlice 及原因；若下游异常，跳对应 skill 并把结论写在该下游对象；若 checkoutservice 侧正常而 frontend 调用失败，回 frontend 并把结论写在 frontend。

## 什么时候跳到别的服务

- checkoutservice 日志/事件出现 productcatalogservice:3550 连接失败、超时，或 productcatalogservice 的 Service/EndpointSlice 无 ready 端点 → 跳 `boutique-productcatalogservice`；结论写 productcatalogservice 对应对象。
- checkoutservice 日志/事件出现 shippingservice:50051 连接失败、超时，或 shippingservice 的 Service/EndpointSlice 无 ready 端点 → 跳 `boutique-shippingservice`；结论写 shippingservice 对应对象。
- checkoutservice 日志/事件出现 paymentservice:50051 连接失败、超时，或 paymentservice 的 Service/EndpointSlice 无 ready 端点 → 跳 `boutique-paymentservice`；结论写 paymentservice 对应对象。
- checkoutservice 日志/事件出现 emailservice:5000 连接失败、超时，或 emailservice 的 Service/EndpointSlice 无 ready 端点 → 跳 `boutique-emailservice`；结论写 emailservice 对应对象。
- checkoutservice 日志/事件出现 currencyservice:7000 连接失败、超时，或 currencyservice 的 Service/EndpointSlice 无 ready 端点 → 跳 `boutique-currencyservice`；结论写 currencyservice 对应对象。
- checkoutservice 日志/事件出现 cartservice:7070 连接失败、超时，或 cartservice 的 Service/EndpointSlice 无 ready 端点 → 跳 `boutique-cartservice`；结论写 cartservice 对应对象。不要直接跳 redis-cart。
- frontend 日志显示无法连接 checkoutservice:5050、调用超时或 5xx，但第 2–7 步确认 checkoutservice Pod、Service、EndpointSlice、日志、资源、探针均正常 → 跳 `boutique-frontend`；结论写在 frontend 对应对象。若 checkoutservice 侧已有异常证据，不要回 frontend，结论写 checkoutservice。
- 不要跳到未直接调用的服务；loadgenerator 仅作为流量来源，不作为跳转或结论对象。

## 结论怎么写

结论必须写清对象、原因、证据：对象写 checkoutservice 的 Deployment/Pod/Service/EndpointSlice，或具体下游/frontend 的对应对象；原因写如 Pod 未 Ready 导致 EndpointSlice 无端点、OOMKilled 触发内存 limit、env 地址错误、探针失败、Service selector/端口错误、下游不可达；证据写 Pod describe 事件、日志原始片段、EndpointSlice ready 状态、Deployment env/镜像/探针/资源 spec、ResourceQuota 事件。

判到下游时，结论写在该下游对象上并注明“checkoutservice 侧仅表现为调用失败”；判到 frontend 时，结论写在 frontend 对象上。

            # Online Boutique 排查总则

## 经验条目

以下条目来自过去的排查记录，括号里是来源。

- [E1]（BH01、BH02、BH03、BH04）先按症状分类：同时报“慢”和“下单失败”通常为两个独立故障，分别定位。失败类：看错误语义与耗时——首次数秒超时后 2–3ms 快速失败=某下游 `*_SERVICE_ADDR` 端口/地址配错（对比当前与上一版 ReplicaSet env、Service port 与容器实际监听端口）；connection refused=Service 无 Endpoints/selector 不匹配，逐个 `get endpoints`。延迟类：看耗时是否与“调用次数”成比例。若多类页面/多个下游同时呈同一固定台阶（每次调用 +200~300ms），而同一窗口内另一组调用仍 1–2.5ms（如 checkout↔shipping/payment/email），说明台阶附着在一批 Pod 上，属运行期延迟注入，不是节点 CPU、全局网络或单服务 CPU 限流（限流应有 cgroup throttle 证据且随负载波动；Pod 健康、配置未变、无 error 也支持此判）。页面耗时≈该页调用受影响服务的次数×台阶，可据此反推受影响集合。也可用时间戳对齐：下游日志“收到请求”晚于调用方发起、而该下游处理仅毫秒级→延迟在到达前。处置：重建这些 Pod；重建后数字完全不变=集群侧按 label 重放的注入（chaos/sidecar/tc），转运维，不要反复重启。以 Pod 创建/版本切换时间为界对比前后基线。
- [E2]（BH05、BH06、BH09）『整站或部分页面变慢、0 个 500、Pod 全 Running/0 重启、env/资源/镜像未变』时按四步收敛，不要先调 CPU limit：①前端日志按路径分桶耗时，用最快路径反证——如 POST /cart 仅 1–2ms，即 productcatalog/cart/redis 全链健康；②页面耗时≈该页调用嫌疑服务的次数×台阶，据此反推唯一嫌疑服务（只有 /cart、/cart/checkout 慢而 /、/product 正常→shippingservice，checkout 约 2×台阶是同一下游 RPC 被调两次）；③复核该服务 Deployment 的 env、资源、镜像、Service targetPort、Endpoints；④时间戳对齐：调用方发出时刻 vs 被查服务 handler 入口日志恒定晚约一个台阶而处理瞬时完成=入向网络延迟（重建该 Pod，无效则转运维查 veth 上 tc/netem），延迟落在响应返回侧则为出向。注入延迟通常小于探针超时，Pod 仍 Ready、无 Unhealthy 事件不能排除网络注入。同一窗口内毫秒级 connection refused（如副本被缩到 0、selector 写错致 Endpoints 为空）只造成降级，按错误语义单独修，不并入延迟归因。
- [E3]（BH07、BH10）同一秒出现 `Scaled up replica set <新> from 0 to 1` 与旧 RS `Scaled down ... from 1 to 0`，通常就是变更注入时刻：以该时间点为准横向检查所有 Deployment 的 replicas、env、镜像，以及所有 Service 的 selector 与 port→targetPort——同一次注入常同时改多个对象（如一个 Service 端口写错 + 另一个 selector 写错）。connection refused 只有两种来源：selector 不匹配致 Endpoints 为空（subsets: null），或 Endpoints 有地址但 targetPort≠容器实际监听端口（对照 containerPort 与 Pod 启动日志 `Now listening on: ...:7070`）。是否算根因取决于调用方能否降级：cartservice/productcatalog 这类每页必经的挂了→大量 500、下单全失败但响应仅 1–3ms（不是资源/延迟问题）；ad、推荐、邮件可降级→页面仍 200 只内容缺失，只单独恢复，不并入延迟/失败归因。修复后按该时刻前后对比：500 归零、下单成功率恢复、对应报错日志消失，延迟分位数不应变差。
- [E4]（BH08）耗时台阶看似卡在某下游、该服务入向指标又不足以解释时，把口径下沉到“下游操作条数”：同一页 1 条缓存/DB 命令≈X ms、2 条≈2X ms，而无该跳的接口仍 0–2ms，则台阶固定在该跳每次往返上（若 2 条接口只有≈1.5X，才是延迟附着在中间 Pod 的整体网络路径）。同时别被“最近变更”误导：某 Deployment 刚 rollout 或 env 与 last-applied 不一致时看时间线——新 Pod 就绪后若曾连续数十秒正常服务，即可排除该变更，回到台阶定位；节点级 CPU/throttle 指标不可得时，用同窗口其他服务毫秒级间接排除节点问题。
- [E5]（BH11、BH12、BH13、BH14、BH15）尾部延迟呈“概率型”：中位数正常、p90/p99 抬高、约 4–9%（也可能到 20%）请求超阈值、无 5xx、Pod 全 Ready、env/资源/镜像未变。不要按 E2 找“每次调用都加台阶的入向延迟”。先看慢值分布定机制：①慢值是基线+100ms 整数倍、成簇、随机 0–100ms→单线程/多模块且 CPU limit 偏低的 Pod 被 CFS 冻结（查 nr_throttled；无权限就只把嫌疑服务的 limit 提到 1）；②慢值量化在 ~200ms（400/600ms）整数倍、各并发请求起跑不同却同一瞬间返回→TCP 重传，问题在被调 Pod 的网络路径；③看本 Pod 探针，`i/o timeout` 或 `timeout: failed to connect service <podIP>:<port> within 1s` 都指向该 Pod 自身的网络或停顿（探针直连 Pod、绕开调用方；同窗口只有它异常即可排除节点级丢包），据此确定是哪个 Pod。确定后一次只重启/修改这一个对象并复测 >180ms 占比，不要同时重启多个候选服务做“验证”，否则无法判断原因，下游日志里的孤立的数百毫秒空档只能当备选证据。用只含单次下游往返的干净区间做严格隔离。

<!-- 经验条目结束 -->

## 1. 权限与证据边界

- 只在命名空间 `boutique` 内排查，使用只读权限。
- 可查看：Pod、Pod 日志、事件、Service、EndpointSlice、Deployment、ReplicaSet、ConfigMap、ResourceQuota。
- 不可用：进入容器执行命令、查看节点、查看监控指标；系统没有 CPU、内存、延迟指标。
- 结论必须来自上述可见证据。无法验证的内容写成“先确认……”或“现有权限内无法确认”，不要根据服务名、调用关系或常见经验直接下根因。
- 不要编造日志格式、接口、配置项；日志字段含义先确认。

## 2. 调用关系

- 用户从 `frontend` 进入。
- `loadgenerator` 持续产生访问流量；其具体访问目标先确认，不纳入下列服务调用图，也不假设存在 `boutique-loadgenerator`。
- `frontend` -> `productcatalogservice`、`currencyservice`、`cartservice`、`recommendationservice`、`shippingservice`、`checkoutservice`、`adservice`
- `checkoutservice` -> `productcatalogservice`、`shippingservice`、`paymentservice`、`emailservice`、`currencyservice`、`cartservice`
- `recommendationservice` -> `productcatalogservice`
- `cartservice` -> `redis-cart`
- 不调用其他服务：`emailservice`、`paymentservice`、`productcatalogservice`、`currencyservice`、`shippingservice`、`adservice`、`redis-cart`

调用关系只表示依赖方向，不等于故障传播方向。

## 3. 入口 SOP 选择

先固定用户症状：发生时间、频率、影响的功能/操作、是否持续、是否与 `loadgenerator` 流量相关。不要先假定某个服务故障。

默认规则：

- 用户可见问题且无法明确指向某个后端服务：从 `boutique-frontend` 进入。
- 症状或已有证据明确指向某个服务及其对应操作：可直接进入该服务 SOP；仍要按第 4 节确认证据，不要跳过入口症状。
- 只有 `loadgenerator` 报错：先确认其访问目标和错误内容；若指向 `frontend` 或用户访问路径，从 `boutique-frontend` 进入。不要假设存在 `loadgenerator` 的 SOP。
- 不明确时回退到 `boutique-frontend`。

| 症状/已有证据明确指向 | 入口 skill |
|---|---|
| `frontend` 页面、入口、多个功能同时异常，或无法判断后端 | `boutique-frontend` |
| 商品目录、商品信息 | `boutique-productcatalogservice` |
| 币种、换算 | `boutique-currencyservice` |
| 购物车操作 | `boutique-cartservice` |
| 推荐内容 | `boutique-recommendationservice` |
| 运费、配送 | `boutique-shippingservice` |
| 下单、结账编排 | `boutique-checkoutservice` |
| 支付 | `boutique-paymentservice` |
| 邮件通知 | `boutique-emailservice` |
| 广告 | `boutique-adservice` |
| 已有证据指向购物车存储 `redis-cart`，或从 `cartservice` SOP 转入 | `boutique-redis-cart` |

## 4. 跨服务跳转原则

1. 只沿调用方向向下游跳，且必须带当前服务侧证据。可跳的证据包括：当前服务的日志、事件或状态显示对某个下游的调用失败、超时、连接失败、返回异常，并能定位到具体下游和操作；或当前服务自身已排除，请求路径明确只可能落在下游。仅凭“它是下游”“它也可能异常”不跳。
2. 跳转前记录：时间、当前服务对象、症状、指向下游的证据、已排除项。到下游后先核对同一时间窗、同一症状是否出现；对不上则回到当前服务，不能把无关异常归因给下游。

```go
func (fe *frontendServer) homeHandler(w, r) {

	products, err := fe.getProducts(...)   // ListProducts

}
```

Actually the header cart badge is rendered with `.cart_size` populated per handler: each handler calls getCart for the badge. Hmm, in v0.10.3, homeHandler does call getCart? Let me think about the currency log pattern per page: each page logs "Getting supported currencies..." once — consistent with getCurrencies per handler.

Actually the badge count: in v0.10.3 templates, base.html has `{{ if .cart_size }}`. And handlers set cart_size... In homeHandler, I'm fairly confident there's `cart, err := fr.getCart(ctx, sessionID(r))` — because the home page shows the cart badge. Hmm. Actually I recall the badge is populated on product page too... 

Let me test empirically with data: find a window with only home pages and count GetCartAsync lines vs "Getting supported currencies" lines (each page = 1). If equal → every page calls cartservice.

We have currency logs with timestamps: "Getting supported currencies" at 47.092 (product), 47.105 (cart), 47.622 (home at 47.62), 47.845 (product at 47.84), 48.100 (cart), 48.455 (cart), 49.789 (cart), 50.101 (home? at 50.10), 51.778 (product)...

Interesting: the "Getting supported currencies" at 48.100, 48.455, 49.789 correspond to cart page starts (47.1047? no). Wait: cart pages started at 47.1047, 48.0999, 48.4544, 49.7889, 51...

So the cart page's FIRST call (getCurrencies) happens immediately at page start. Then the gap to the next observable event is the conversions at 47.430, right after shipping at 47.4298.

So for cart page #1: currency (47.105) → [gap 325ms] → shipping (47.4298) → conversions (47.430-47.434).

For cart page #2 (48.0999): currency at 48.100 → conversions at 48.411, 48.413, 48.414 and shipping received at 48.4103. Same pattern.

Hmm, but here's a thought: the number of conversions after shipping = 3 (48.411, 48.413, 48.414) and 4 for page 1. In the cart page, after getting items, convertCurrency per item + shipping = items+1 conversions. So ~3 items.

I need to determine whether cartservice/redis or productcatalog is slow, or the shipping RPC.

Both finishing at the same instant → both were waiting on the same downstream stall: the connection to productcatalogservice:3551! Since port 3551 has no listener, the TCP SYN to ClusterIP:3551 goes nowhere → hangs until timeout (18.5s / 5.9s both ending when...? hmm, they'd time out independently at different times).

Both completed at 10:28:18.1145 — sub-millisecond the same. That's characteristic of a blocked-then-released shared resource... Actually gRPC: the first RPC triggers a connection attempt (dial to productcatalogservice:3551). Backoff: initial connect timeout could be ~20s; both RPCs wait on the same SubConn. When the SubConn fails, both fail together → both error at once. Yes! That's the classic "wait for ready" behavior in gRPC (WaitForReady default? checkoutservice uses grpc.WithBlock at startup... hmm).

Actually the checkoutservice at startup uses `grpc.DialContext` with `WithBlock()` for each downstream — if productcatalogservice:3551 were unreachable, the pod would fail to start ("failed to dial"). Unless... iptables for ClusterIP has a REJECT rule for unmatched port? Actually kube-proxy only adds rules for the service ports it defines; for other ports to the ClusterIP, the packet is DNATed? No — with iptables mode, a service with port 3550 only installs rules matching dport 3550. A SYN to 3551 has no DNAT rule; the ClusterIP is a virtual IP not assigned to any interface, so packets are dropped (no route → default route via eth0, but 10.96.32.253 isn't routable → the SYN goes out to the network and gets no answer, effectively a black hole → TCP connect timeout).

So connect attempts hang → i/o timeout. Then gRPC WithBlock dial would take a long time. But the pod started fine and is Ready at 10:27:57+... and probe is a gRPC health probe (grpc_health_probe on port 5050 of the pod) which works.

Hmm — but if the checkoutservice dialed with WithBlock and it blocked, the pod wouldn't listen at 10:27:58. It did listen. So maybe the frontend/checkout uses `grpc.Dial` non-blocking, and the first RPC discovers the channel isn't ready.

Actually gRPC fails fast when the SubConn is in TRANSIENT_FAILURE.

Hmm, actually 1-2ms fast failures = RPC fails immediately because no ready subchannel. And the first two hung while initial connect attempts were pending. That still points to the misconfigured port.

Let me confirm the error messages for those two slow checkouts. Also let me check whether productcatalogservice Service has port 3551 (no, only 3550). Confirmed.

Let's check shipping pod details/events and its deployment env, plus whether shippingservice RS is old (created 11-15) — it is old (78969f44cf appears in pod list as shippingservice-78969f44cf-fvxjd). So all pods were restarted at 10:27:04 but with the same RS for most — meaning pods were deleted and recreated (e.g. someone deleted pods, or a rollout with same template? No—same RS, so pods were deleted). Interesting: all pods recreated at 10:27:04 except checkoutservice whose RS changed at 10:27:57 (env change). So at 10:27:04 all deployments' pods were recreated (deleted/recreated by RS during a "rollout restart"? A rollout restart creates a NEW RS. Same RS recreated pods = pods deleted manually, or the deployment was scaled to 0 and back, or... hmm).

Wait: ReplicaSet creation timestamps: checkoutservice-5d5f4589c5 created 11-15; emailservice-558899d44c 11-15; frontend-fd686dbb 11-15. And pods all created 10:27:04 today. So pods were deleted at 10:27:04 and recreated in the same RS. That's consistent with `kubectl delete pods --all` or a node drain/restart. Whatever — it's the "incident setup" moment: at ~10:27 the environment was reset, and the checkoutservice deployment's env was also modified (new RS at 10:27:57).

So the fault injection moment ~10:27:04-10:27:57.

So for shipping: pod 10:27:04. Is there any deployment/env change for shipping? Let's check all deployments' current env vs RS to catch other changes (e.g., a Service port change, or shipping's service). Let's dump deployments spec env and compare with old RSes across services. That's the E3 approach: at the change moment, check all Deployments env, image, replicas and all Services' selector/port.

messages.reasoning_content:
Confirmed the slow checkouts (5.6s, 18.5s) also failed with "failed to get product" — all three at 10:28:18.114 (all resolved at once). So a single shared connection-resolution event: gRPC channel to productcatalogservice:3551. That's consistent with the wrong port.

Frontend env: SHIPPING_SERVICE_ADDR=shippingservice:50051 correct, PRODUCT_CATALOG_SERVICE_ADDR=productcatalogservice:3550 correct. So frontend fine; only checkoutservice's env wrong. And frontend's checkout failures are just propagation.

Now for the latency. Frontend env correct. So the ~300ms is either shipping transit or frontend's own gRPC connection behavior for the shipping call.

Hmm. Interesting alternative: the frontend has a gRPC connection pool with lazy channels... but shipping is called only by the cart page (and checkout). If a gRPC channel to shipping sits idle for long, gRPC would keep the connection alive (keepalive)... Actually if the connection is closed when idle and each new dial needs a fresh TCP handshake, that would be ~1 RTT (few ms), not 300ms.

300ms is characteristic of: TCP SYN retransmission (initial RTO ~1s, not 300) — no. Or netem delay 100/150ms and 2-3 RTTs. Or the frontend's HTTP/2 connect + TLS? no TLS.

Hmm. Also possible: DNS? Frontend uses gRPC dial with target "shippingservice:50051" — DNS resolution via Go resolver. If DNS lookup is slow (~300ms) for shipping only... hmm! Nameserver search domains/timeouts could add 300ms per lookup. But gRPC keeps the connection.

Hmm, but wait: what if the connection to shipping is being *closed* between requests, requiring a re-dial each time? 300ms could be DNS + connect. But DNS would affect ALL services, not just shipping.

Let's look for corroborating evidence: Does the checkout flow's shipping call show the same delay? Can't (fails earlier).

What about the frontend calling checkoutservice? The /cart/checkout requests: fast-fail 1-2ms once failed; the initial 3 hung.

Alternatively: maybe the ~300ms delay is in the frontend's *shipping quote* calculation which does currency conversion... no.

Hmm, let me reconsider one thing: The cart page duration ≈ 300ms. Could there be a call to `shippingservice` twice? No.

A cleaner discriminator: measure the total count of GetQuote receipts vs cart pages. If GetQuote count == cart page count, then each cart page does exactly one shipping call and the delay is on that call.

messages.reasoning_content:
Transition point identified: GET /cart at 10:28:24.108 = 9ms (fast); next GET /cart at 10:28:26.867 = 283ms (slow). So onset between 10:28:24.11 and 10:28:26.87.

Also interesting: at 10:27:57.402 there's a successful checkout POST /cart/checkout 200 in 86ms — before the checkoutservice env change (pod replaced at 10:27:57-59). Wait, the old pod was killed at 10:27:59 and new started 10:27:58. The 200 at 10:27:57.40 was handled by the old (correct) checkoutservice. Good — confirms old RS was fine and the new RS with port 3551 is broken.

Now for onset of cart slowness: ~10:28:25-26. What happened at that time? Nothing in k8s events. Pods all existed since 10:27:04.

Hmm! So the cart slowness onset at ~10:28:26 is a runtime change, no k8s object change (no events, no pod restarts). That is consistent with a chaos-style latency injection (tc/netem) on a pod's network path, or something inside a pod.

Which pod? The delay appears on the cart page (+~300ms). If it were injected on the *frontend* pod's network, all downstream calls would be delayed — product page (which calls catalog, currency, recommendation, ads) is 9ms, home 12-58ms. So not the frontend.

So it's specific to one downstream used only by the cart page = shippingservice. This nails it: shippingservice pod's network path is delayed ~300ms inbound (or its gRPC handling).

But wait — could it be a delay attached to the shipping pod causing the *request* to be delayed? We saw shipping "GetQuote received request" at page_start+300ms and "completed" instantly → the delay occurs before the request reaches shipping's handler. Combined with 0 restarts, Ready, no probe failures (1s timeout tolerance), and instant handler processing → this is inbound network delay on shippingservice pod (or tc on its veth), not CPU/resource.

Additional confirmation: is the 300ms delay consistent per RPC and not per byte? Yes ~300ms.

Hmm, but one more alternative: the frontend→shipping gRPC connection might be getting torn down and re-established, e.g., the frontend's idle connection... but the frontend's other gRPC channels would behave similarly.

Another possibility: DNS. The frontend resolves shippingservice periodically (gRPC re-resolves on connection failure). If conntrack/DNS... eh.

Hmm, note cart page = 1 shipping call and cart page delay ~300ms. Also: when a cart page has an empty cart (bytes 6857 vs 16400), it's still ~8ms earlier / slow later. Empty cart page still calls GetQuote? If cart is empty, viewCartHandler returns early (redirect to /cart/empty?) Actually it renders with empty items but still calls getShippingQuote maybe. Note the slow ones include 6871 bytes (10:28:27.659, 337ms) — an empty cart page, still slow → so the slow part isn't per-item; it's the shipping call. Good.

Now, could the 300ms be inside the shipping pod (e.g., added sleep in handler)? Shipping logs "received request" then "completed request" at the same instant. If the code slept 300ms between receive-log and completed-log, we'd see the gap. We see receipt already 300ms late. So the delay is before the handler entry → the network path/pod ingress, e.g. netem on veth, or... hmm, one more: if the delay were on the *client* side (frontend's outbound), then frontend sends at 47.107 and packet arrives 47.43 → the packet in flight. Same thing: the delay is on the frontend→shipping network path. Either direction attribution (frontend egress vs shipping ingress) can't be fully separated with only these logs.

But since only the shipping leg is affected while all other legs from the same frontend pod are fast, the delay is attached to shippingservice's network path (the per-pod qdisc on the shipping pod's veth would delay that pod's traffic; frontend-side egress filtering by port/peer would too). Per skill E2: "延迟附着在一批 Pod 上，属运行期延迟注入" and "重建这些 Pod，无效则转运维查 veth 上 tc/netem".

Hmm, but I should double check whether the delay is inbound-only or round-trip: shipping's response reaches the frontend quickly (page completes 5ms after shipping logs completion). If the injection delayed both directions, the page would complete ~600ms later. Since the response came back in ~5ms, the delay is one-directional: request direction only (frontend→shipping ingress). Interesting — netem delay on the shipping pod's veth ingress? Actually tc qdisc on veth typically delays egress. A delay applied to shipping pod's egress would delay the *response* — but we see the request arriving late, not the response. Hmm!

So: request arrives 322ms late; response returns in ~5ms. If tc egress netem were on the frontend pod's veth, all outbound traffic (to all services) would be delayed — no, other calls fast.

If tc egress netem were on the shipping pod's veth, the *response* would be delayed 300ms, and shipping would log receipt immediately (~5ms after page start), with the frontend waiting 300ms for the response. What did we observe? shipping received at page_start + 322ms. That is NOT the shipping-egress case.

So the request was delayed in flight: something delayed the *inbound* packets. That could be:
- frontend egress qdisc delayed for that specific flow (e.g., netem with filter on dest IP/port) — possible in chaos injection with filters;
- or ingress delay on shipping's veth (tc ingress + ifb) — the standard way to delay a pod's inbound traffic.

Either way, the affected object is shippingservice (the only service whose traffic is delayed).

Hmm wait, but hold on. Let me reconsider the whole cart page again. What if the delay isn't the shipping call but rather the *frontend's* handling of the gRPC channel to shipping... 

Alternatively, maybe I've got the shipping call position wrong: what if the cart page calls shipping FIRST and then currency etc.? No — currency ListCurrencies logged at page start (fast), so currency is first.

Hmm, but actually: what if the delay is in `cartservice` for the empty-cart/GetCart? We know home page also calls cartservice... let me verify home page calls cartservice at all in v0.10.3. If home does NOT call cartservice, then cartservice is unmeasured except POST /cart (AddItemAsync, 1-2ms) — POST /cart does call cartservice AddItemAsync, which involves redis write; fast. But GetCartAsync (a read) could be delayed... a delay attached to the cartservice pod's network path would delay BOTH AddItem (1-2ms) and GetCart. POST /cart = 1-2ms → cartservice path is fine. ✓ Ruled out.

And productcatalog: POST /cart calls getProduct (1-2ms) → catalog fine ✓.
Currency: getCurrencies at page start instant ✓.
So the only remaining hop = shippingservice. Good, solid.

Also: is the cart page's `getShippingQuote` really reaching shipping for every cart page? The elapsed is ~300ms = one shipping round trip. Yes.

Let me now double-check the onset correlation: at 10:28:24 GET /cart was 9ms, at 10:28:26.867 283ms. So onset ≈ 10:28:25. Also the huge checkout stalls ended at 10:28:18 (gRPC channel to bad port resolution timeout). Slightly before onset. Two independent faults, roughly coincident but distinct.

Wait, one thing to check: is the *checkout* failure onset also then? Checkout succeeded at 10:27:57 (86ms, 200) and the new checkoutservice pod came up at 10:27:58 with port 3551. They all ended at the same instant, i.e., when the channel's connect attempt to 10.96.32.253:3551 failed/timed out (TCP SYN retries → ~18.5s? Hmm they'd have started at different times, so the common end time suggests a shared wait, ending when the subchannel failed).

Anyway, the checkout failure cause is the wrong port. Confirmed by the pod's own startup log: "service config: &{... productCatalogSvcAddr:productcatalogservice:3551 ...}".

Let me also verify that checkoutservice's old pod log (before kill) shows fails? Not needed.

One more check on the cart latency: is any other page consistently slow? Home max 107ms, avg 26, median 19. Product ~10ms. So home varies 12-107 — occasional +90ms spikes (maybe ad service hiccups). Not the main story.

Let me also verify that the shipping pod is the only shipping endpoint and its IP is 10.244.0.242, and that no other pod has an issue. Also check whether there is a checkoutservice→shipping effect... irrelevant.

Now, to strengthen the shipping attribution, let me check the GetQuote receipt times for cart pages and confirm they equal page_start + ~300ms even for the empty-cart page at 10:28:26.867 (start ≈ 10:28:26.53). Let's fetch shipping logs around 10:28:26 and 10:28:24 to show the pattern: expect GetQuote received at ~26.86 for the cart page started 26.53, and for the fast 9ms cart page at 10:28:24.098 (started 24.098? actually GET /cart at 24.1088 with 9ms → start 24.0998) → GetQuote received at ~24.107.

That would be a nice before/after contrast! Let's fetch shipping logs 10:28:23.5-10:28:27.

Excellent! Decisive:
- Fast cart page: GET /cart completed 10:28:24.1088 (took 9ms → started 24.0998). Shipping GetQuote received at 24.1049 = start + 5ms, completed instantly, page done 24.1088 (4ms later). ✅ normal.
- Slow cart page: GET /cart completed 10:28:26.8672 (took 283ms → started 26.584). Shipping GetQuote received at 26.8629 = start + 279ms, completed instantly, page done 26.8672 (4ms later). ✅ delayed.
- Slow cart page: completed 10:28:27.6592 (337ms → started 27.322). Shipping received 27.6567 = start + 335ms.

So the entire ~300ms is consumed between page start and the GetQuote arriving at shippingservice's handler; the frontend then finishes ~4ms after shipping responds. Since all other hops on the cart page are proven fast, the ~300ms delay is on the frontend→shippingservice request path (in-flight), attached to shippingservice.

Note nuance: this could be attributed to shipping pod ingress or frontend→shipping flow. Since (a) only shipping is affected while all other legs are sub-ms/ms, and (b) shipping's own handler processes instantly, the object is shippingservice's network path.

Hmm, one caveat: could the delay be in the frontend's gRPC client for shipping specifically (e.g., connection re-establishment each call)? If the channel to shipping were being re-dialed each time, we'd expect delay in the client, and shipping would receive 300ms after the send... but we can't tell "send" time. However, if the frontend were re-dialing each time, the first RPC would need to wait for connection... 300ms is too short for a dial failure and too long for a local TCP connect (~1ms). And shipping's connection would be long-lived.

Also: is shipping's delay possibly on the response path (shipping→frontend), with the frontend sending at page_start+322ms for another reason? No — page completes 4ms after shipping's receipt, so the round trip after receipt is 4ms. If the delay were on the response path, the frontend would still be waiting 300ms after shipping's completion. It wasn't. So the 300ms is before shipping's handler. Solid.

One more possibility: the *frontend* delayed before sending GetQuote because of its own CPU/throttling mid-handler... but then the delay would affect other pages/handlers too; also the delay is uniform ~300ms and appears exactly once per cart page. Could the frontend be blocked in an earlier *sequential* call for 300ms that isn't logged by the callee? The callee logs would show receipts: currency (5ms), cart[no ts], catalog[no logs]. Cart is a suspect but POST /cart proves cartservice path fast... unless GetCart (read) is slower than AddItem (write)? Both are single redis ops; and GetCart on the cart page fetches HGETALL. Hmm, cartservice pod's network path delayed would delay AddItem too → POST /cart is 1-2ms ✓ so not cartservice.

Also home page: does it call cartservice? If home = 12-58ms and calls cart GetCart, that's another proof. Let's verify quickly by counting GetCartAsync lines in a 10s window vs total requests... meh. I have enough proof via POST /cart.

Hmm, but hold on: POST /cart's AddItemAsync is a cartservice call and it's 1-2ms. Great.

So conclusion #2: shippingservice — ~300ms added latency on the frontend→shippingservice request path (network-level, since the shipping handler starts 280-335ms after the frontend begins the cart page and takes <1ms to process; no restarts, Ready, no probe failures).

Wait — but I should double check one alternative: the `getShippingQuote` call in the cart handler might be preceded by nothing, and maybe the frontend's cart handler makes TWO shipping calls? No.

Additionally consider: maybe the delay comes from frontend's `getShippingQuote` being called AFTER a 300ms stall in `getProducts` when the cart has many items... The empty-cart page (6871 bytes, 337ms) has 0-1 items, still ~335ms. So it's not per-item. It's a single ~300ms step per cart page. ✓

Now: how does this explain the "6 500s" in the 45s window? Those 6 500s = checkout failures (all 500 from /cart/checkout). 6 checkouts all failed. ✓ matches user report exactly.

And 33/184 > 180ms = the cart page views (~300ms). ✓

Both faults are on overlapping window but distinct objects:
1. checkoutservice Deployment (new RS checkoutservice-6d4fdcc4b4, pod checkoutservice-6d4fdcc4b4-jrps7): env PRODUCT_CATALOG_SERVICE_ADDR=productcatalogservice:3551 (should be 3550) → every PlaceOrder fails at "failed to prepare order: failed to get product" → 100% checkout failure, fast-fail 1-2ms (with initial 5.9s/18.5s hangs).
2. shippingservice pod shippingservice-78969f44cf-fvxjd (10.244.0.242): ~280-335ms added latency on inbound request path from frontend; GetQuote handler executes in <100µs; only the cart page (and checkout) uses it → cart page ~300ms, 17.9% of requests > 180ms.

Also worth mentioning: frontend and other services healthy; productcatalog/currency/cart/redis fast.

Let me do a final couple of checks:
- Confirm the checkoutservice deployment (not just RS) currently has 3551 — the deployment spec would reflect the RS template. Let's check deployment env to report the object precisely.
- Check whether productcatalogservice interface listens on 3550 only (containerPort 3550, service 3550) ✓.
- Maybe check whether there's a Service for productcatalog with port 3551 - no.

Also check ResourceQuota? Not needed.

Let me verify deployment checkoutservice env and also double check there's no second shipping pod / whether shipping's delay could be from a second container (sidecar) in the pod. Let's check the shipping pod spec containers list.

messages.content:
I found a skill named **boutique-triage-overview（Online Boutique 排查总则）** and **boutique-checkoutservice** and used them to troubleshoot:

1. ✅ *按症状分类* — "慢"和"下单失败"是两个独立故障，分开定位
2. ✅ *列出全部 Pod/Service/EndpointSlice* — 12 个 Pod 全 Running、0 重启、0 ready=0 的端点；各 Service selector/port 与 endpoint 端口一致（emailservice 5000→8080 属正常）
3. ✅ *对比 Deployment / ReplicaSet env 与 revision* — 抓到 checkoutservice 的 env 漂移
4. ✅ *读 checkoutservice 启动日志与 frontend 错误日志* — 定位失败阶段与错误语义
5. ✅ *前端日志按路径分桶耗时* — 只有 `GET /cart`（~300ms）异常，`/product` 9–12ms、`/` 12–58ms、`POST /cart` 1–2ms
6. ✅ *时间戳对齐（调用方发起 vs 下游 handler 入口）* — 把 300ms 定位到 frontend→shippingservice 这一段
7. ✅ *loadgenerator 统计交叉验证* — 确认慢的只有 cart 页
8. ❌ *查看节点 / tc/netem / CPU throttle 指标* — 无节点、无监控指标权限，无法进一步确认延迟注入方式
9. ❌ *重建 Pod 验证是否集群侧重放* — 只读权限，不能执行

---

## 结论：两个互不相关的故障

### 故障 A — 所有下单失败（500）：checkoutservice 的下游地址端口写错

`Deployment/checkoutservice`（revision 92，新 RS `checkoutservice-6d4fdcc4b4`，pod `checkoutservice-6d4fdcc4b4-jrps7`）自身的启动日志直接打出错误配置：

```
service config: &{... productCatalogSvcAddr:productcatalogservice:3551 ...}
```

- 旧 RS `checkoutservice-5d5f4589c5`（replicas 0，11-15 创建）与 `kubectl.kubernetes.io/last-applied-configuration` 都是 **`productcatalogservice:3550`**，只有当前运行态是 **3551** → 运行态被改。
- `Service/productcatalogservice` 只暴露 3550→3550，容器 `containerPort` 也是 3550，3551 无 listener/kube-proxy 规则。
- 后果与错误语义吻合：frontend `POST /cart/checkout` 全部 500，`took_ms` 只有 1–2ms（快速失败）：
  `{"error":"failed to complete the order: rpc error: code = Internal desc = failed to prepare order: failed to get product #\"2ZYFJ3GM2N\"" ... "took_ms":2}`
- 通道首次解析时曾挂住：10:28:18.114 三个 checkout 同时以 18536ms / 5932ms / 5641ms 失败结束（同一瞬间释放，符合 gRPC 对不可达后端的连接尝试超时）。
- 反证：10:27:57.402 旧 Pod 还在时 `POST /cart/checkout` 返回 **200，86ms**；换到新 RS 后 100% 失败。loadgenerator 统计 `POST /cart/checkout 23 reqs, 22 fails (95.65%), median 3ms`。

### 故障 B — 商城变慢：frontend→shippingservice 请求路径多出约 300ms

购物车页是全站唯一调用 shippingservice 的页面（`GetQuote`），它的耗时 100% 从 ~9ms 跳到 ~283–351ms。逐条时间戳对齐（同一秒内）：

| 购物车页 | 页面开始 | shipping 收到 GetQuote | shipping 处理 | 页面完成 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 正常（10:28:24） | 24.0998 | 24.1049 (**+5ms**) | <0.1ms | 24.1088 |
| 异常（10:28:26） | 26.584 | 26.8629 (**+279ms**) | <0.1ms | 26.8672 |
| 异常（10:28:27） | 27.322 | 27.6567 (**+335ms**) | <0.1ms | 27.6592 |

即：请求到达 shippingservice handler 前已经晚了约 300ms，handler 本身瞬时完成，之后 4–5ms 页面就结束了 → 延迟在**请求方向**的前端→shippingservice 链路上，不在 shipping 的业务逻辑、也不是响应返回侧。

同页其它跳全部被证明是毫秒级，因此可以排除它们：
- currencyservice：页面开始的 `getCurrencies` 在 +0ms 就到达（47.092/47.105/48.100/48.455/49.789…），瞬时返回；
- cartservice + redis：`POST /cart`（AddItemAsync，写 redis）全程 **1–2ms**；
- productcatalogservice：`POST /cart` 里的 GetProduct **1–2ms**，`GET /product/*` 全链 8–14ms；
- recommendationservice：`GET /product/*` 含推荐调用仍 8–14ms（且购物车页并不调用推荐）。

shippingservice 自身状态完全正常：pod `shippingservice-78969f44cf-fvxjd`（10.244.0.242）Ready、restartCount 0、单容器无 sidecar、镜像 v0.10.3、env `PORT=50051`/`DISABLE_PROFILER=1` 与 last-applied 一致、无任何 Pod 事件；探针周期 5s/10s、超时 1s，300ms 小于超时所以不会触发 Unhealthy（与"无 Unhealthy 事件"一致，不能据此排除延迟）。

时间线：10:28:24.109 的购物车页还是 9ms，10:28:26.867 已变 283ms → 注入起点约在 **10:28:25**，此时无任何 Pod 重建/配置变更（Pod 都是 10:27:04 创建），属运行期网络侧变化。loadgenerator 汇总印证：`GET /cart` min 8 / median 310 / max 352，`POST /cart` median 310（locust 跟随 302 跳转），其余接口 median 10–23ms。

用户侧的 184/45s 指标对得上：33 个 >180ms 正好约等于购物车页的访问量（~0.7/s），6 个 500 / 6 次下单失败全部来自 checkoutservice。
